flows.title: Duplicate a site
steps: This needs the Site creation permission, and site backups do not come across to the copy.
On your dashboard, click the three dots menu next to the site you want to copy, then click Duplicate.
Type a name for the new site, then click Copy. The duplicated site appears in the site list on your dashboard.

flows.title: Export the site list to CSV
steps: Only Account Owners and Staff Members can do this, and a Staff Member's file holds only what they are allowed to see in the platform.
Click the three horizontal dots icon next to the Create New Site button.
Select Export CSV. A success message appears and the CSV file is sent to your account email in .zip format.
